basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer living in Seattle. I've recently taken up growing marijuana as a hobby and am still learning the ropes. I'm interested in technology, gaming, and sustainable living. You can find me online mostly during evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring the great outdoors. I'm always looking for new hobbies to dive into.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to growing marijuana, most of my knowledge comes from online research and community forums. I'm a quick learner, relying heavily on YouTube tutorials and Reddit threads to guide my journey. My background in software development gives me a knack for troubleshooting and problem-solving.
